summary: Iteration 145: Execution Hub Visibility Security Fix - All backend tests passed (17/17). Frontend verified working. The per-goal visibility feature (private/team/org) is correctly implemented. Cross-org data leak is fixed - Pame (different org) cannot see admin's goals. Visibility selector in create dialog shows 3 options with explanatory text. Goal cards show visibility badges.
critical_code_review_comments: execution_hub.py get_execution_goals correctly implements 5-step visibility filtering: 1) owner_id match (always visible), 2) company_id + visibility=org, 3) task assignee + visibility=team, 4) execution_access (explicit sharing), 5) shared_entities (cross-org explicit sharing)
check_goal_access respects visibility - private goals return 403 for non-owner org members, team goals return 403 for non-assignees
Backwards compatibility maintained - goals without visibility field default to 'org'
Cross-org access removed from blanket membership - now only via explicit sharing (shared_entities + execution_access)
